provenance.existing: docs/design-confirmation-brief.md requires cost, effect and applicable conditions for four investments: craft tools, staff capability, extra stations and semi-automatic equipment. spec line 212 lists staff capability as a screen. The skilled grade reproduces the single employee in design/economy-candidate.json exactly, so nothing already balanced moves.
provenance.new: The three grades, their salaries, assembly multipliers, failure multipliers, recruitment costs and training costs are original game balance.
provenance.limits: Three named grades, not a continuous skill system. It says what a worker of each grade costs and produces, and does not model individual attributes, morale or turnover.

rules.skilledIsTheExistingWorker: The middle grade must match the confirmed employee exactly, so the change is additive
rules.trainingUpgradesInPlace: Training raises a worker one grade for a one-off cost, without recruiting a new person
rules.higherGradeNeverWorse: A higher grade must never cost more in time or produce more defects than a lower one
rules.gradeAffectsQuality: Assembly speed and defect rate both move with grade, so a senior worker is worth more than their hours alone
